usage: 混凝土 (concrete) is used as a noun to refer to the building material made from cement, water, and aggregates.
You can use 混凝土 to talk about construction materials or the structure of buildings.
混凝土 is often used as the subject or object in a sentence when discussing building projects.
It can describe both dried solid form and the wet mixture before it sets.
When talking about construction, 混凝土 can be modified by adjectives or quantifiers, like 'new 混凝土' or 'a lot of 混凝土'.
